semantic_unit.target: Cargo stable DirectorySource handling of missing/unparsable .cargo-checksum.json and checksum/file mismatch
semantic_unit.action: Inspected exactly the official stable Cargo DirectorySource rustdoc and linked stable source for cargo/sources/directory.rs; no Cargo command or dependency repository was inspected.
semantic_unit.result: Missing or unreadable .cargo-checksum.json and JSON parse failure abort DirectorySource::update, and the rustdoc states that failure to find or parse a single checksum denies loading any package in the source. A checksum mismatch is not rejected during initial directory enumeration: DirectorySource stores parsed checksums, then Source::verify hashes every file listed in checksum.files and returns an error when hashing fails (including a listed file that cannot be read) or when the SHA256 differs. Thus fail-closed behavior is verified for missing/unparsable checksum metadata at source-load time and for listed-file missing/content-mismatch at package verification time; these are distinct stages.

public_sources.observed: requires .cargo-checksum.json beside Cargo.toml and states a failure to find or parse one checksum denies loading any package in the source
update propagates checksum file read/JSON decode errors; verify hashes each checksum.files entry, propagates file hashing errors, and bails on digest mismatch
